headline: Rijiju hits back at Rahuls compromised PM jibe, questions Congress on 1962 war, poverty
content: Slamming the Congress over Rahul Gandhi's "compromised PM" remark against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju on Saturday asked the opposition party to answer four questions, including whether it would apologise for the "1962 humiliation" and why it kept India a "poor nation".In a post on X, Rijiju said, "Congress must answer 4 questions: My village was occupied by China in 1962. Will Congress apologise for the 1962 humiliation? 2. Congress kept India a poor nation. Why? 3. Why was India called the land of snake charmers? 4. Why was India's economy insulted as Hindu rate of growth?"Rijiju's remarks came after Gandhi took a swipe at Modi over a trilateral meeting involving US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China on Thursday."If Congress were in power, India's Prime Minister would be sitting at this table. A compromised PM can never sit at this table," Gandhi had said in a post on X, sharing a photograph of the three leaders at the meeting.Talking to reporters here on Friday, Rijiju also said Gandhi should not make statements against India, whether at home or abroad.The Congress leader's remarks triggered a war of words between the BJP and the opposition party, with several BJP leaders accusing Gandhi of being "clueless" about global geopolitics.The ruling party mocked Gandhi's remarks by sharing an AI-generated image showing the Congress leader serving drinks to the US president at the trilateral meeting in China.Sharing the image on X, Bharatiya Janata Party's national spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia took a dig at Gandhi with the caption, "Kuch aise (Something like this)", accompanied by laughing and fire emojis.

headline: Cheema slams Bihar govt over ‘Nitish Setu’, urges PM to name bridge after Guru Gobind Singh
content: Senior Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader and Punjab Cabinet Minister Harpal Singh Cheema on Saturday strongly condemned the Bihar Government’s decision to name the Kachchi Dargah–Bidupur six-lane bridge ‘Nitish Setu’, despite the Bihar Assembly having earlier been informed that a proposal to name the bridge after Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji was under consideration.Reacting to the decision, senior AAP leader and Cabinet Minister Harpal Singh Cheema said that going back on a proposal to honour Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the Tenth Sikh Guru, was deeply hurtful and an affront to Sikh sentiments.He termed the move an unfortunate politicisation of the revered Guru’s legacy. “If the Bihar Government wishes to honour Nitish Kumar, it can find a hundred other ways to do so. However, reneging on a proposal to honour Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji is deeply hurtful and completely unacceptable,” he said.The Punjab Cabinet Minister further asserted that the decision had hurt the sentiments of the Sikh community and urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi not to inaugurate the bridge in its present form.“Prime Minister Narendra Modi must not inaugurate this bridge in its present form,” he stated, urging the authorities to reconsider the decision and respect the sentiments associated with Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji.Punjab Vidhan Sabha Speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan also appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi not to go ahead with the renaming of the Kachchi Dargah–Bidupur bridge, urging him to respect the sentiments of the Sikh community and the people of Bihar.“The Bihar Government had earlier initiated the process of naming the bridge after Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji in response to public demand, but the decision to name it after former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar is deeply hurtful,” he said.The Punjab Vidhan Sabha Speaker pointed out, “There may be thousands of other ways to honour Nitish Kumar Ji, but the bridge should be named after Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji, as originally proposed. No one can erase the name of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji from the hearts of Punjabis and people across the country.”AAP Punjab Chief Spokesperson and MLA Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal termed the Bihar Government’s decision to name the Kachchi Dargah–Bidupur bridge after Nitish Kumar instead of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji a grave insult to Sikh sentiments.“The bridge, built at a cost of Rs 4,300 crore near Takht Sri Patna Sahib, was earlier proposed to be named after the Tenth Sikh Guru Sahib because of its proximity to the revered Sikh shrine,” he added.Questioning the BJP’s justification that Nitish Kumar had brought about major changes in Bihar, Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal said that no political leader’s contribution could be placed above the supreme legacy of Sri Guru Gobind Singh.He urged the Prime Minister to ensure that the bridge retains the name of the Tenth Sikh Guru and appealed to Sri Akal Takht Sahib, the SGPC and other Sikh organisations to take serious note of the decision and seek accountability from those responsible.

headline: Warehousing officer suicide case: SC protects ex-Punjab minister Laljit Bhullar’s father from arrest, rejects PA’s bail plea
content: The Supreme Court has granted interim protection from arrest to Sukhdev Singh Bhullar, father of former Punjab Cabinet Minister Laljit Singh Bhullar, in the high-profile suicide case of Punjab Warehousing Corporation district manager Gagandeep Singh Randhawa.The court, however, dismissed the bail plea of Dilbagh Singh, the former minister’s Personal Assistant (PA) and the third accused in the case.A Bench of Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra and Justice Chandrashekhar directed that Sukhdev Singh Bhullar, aged around 77 and stated to be suffering from multiple ailments, shall not be arrested in connection with the abetment-to-suicide case registered at the Ranjit Avenue police station in Amritsar.The next hearing on Bhullar’s plea has been scheduled for February 8, 2027. The interim protection from arrest will remain subject to his cooperation with the investigation, the court said.Bhullar had challenged the Punjab and Haryana High Court’s order rejecting his anticipatory bail plea. His counsel argued before the apex court that the deceased, in a video recorded shortly before his death, had accused Laljit Singh Bhullar of harassment but had made no allegation against his father.The case dates back to March 21, when 45-year-old Randhawa allegedly died by suicide at his residence. Before his death, he recorded a 12-second video purportedly naming the then Cabinet Minister Laljit Singh Bhullar. The video triggered a political controversy, following which Bhullar resigned from the Cabinet on the same day. He was subsequently arrested.An FIR was registered on March 22 at the Ranjit Avenue police station on a complaint lodged by Randhawa’s wife, Opinder Kaur, against Laljit Singh Bhullar, his father Sukhdev Singh Bhullar, Dilbagh Singh and others.The accused face allegations of abetment to suicide, criminal intimidation and acting with common intention. A provision relating to destruction of evidence was also added subsequently.Earlier, the Punjab and Haryana High Court had rejected the anticipatory bail pleas of Sukhdev Singh Bhullar and Dilbagh Singh. The prosecution had cited pending recoveries of a DVR, pistol and mobile phones, besides apprehensions of witnesses being influenced and evidence being tampered with. It had also argued that custodial interrogation was necessary.Sarabjit Singh Verka, a human rights activist and legal counsel for the victim’s family, said that the Supreme Court, in its order on November 17, also issued a notice to the Punjab Government, which accepted notice and undertook to file a counter-affidavit before the next hearing.Opinder Kaur, wife of the deceased, said the family would file its response in court soon. She alleged that the accused had misled the court and concealed facts to secure anticipatory bail. She also alleged that witnesses were being threatened and influenced.“We will file the response in the next hearing,” she said.

headline: Chahal expresses gratitude to PM Modi after being invited to BJPs OBC Morcha
content: New Delhi [India], November 22 (ANI): Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal on Saturday thanked the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leadership after being appointed Special Invitee to the party's National OBC Morcha executive committee.BJP national president Nitin Nabin on Saturday announced new appointments of national office-bearers, national executive members, and department heads for its Other Backward Classes (OBC) Morcha, effective immediately.Taking to X, Chahal thanked Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, BJP National President Nitin Nabin and OBC Morcha National President Amarpal Maurya for giving him a place in the party."I sincerely thank respected Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji, respected Home Minister Shri Amit Shah ji, BJP National President Shri Nitin Naveen ji, and OBC Morcha National President Shri Amarpal Maurya ji for giving me a place and respect within the BJP family," Chahal wrote.According to the official communication issued by the party’s central office, the list includes seven national vice presidents, three national general secretaries, and seven national secretaries representing various states across the country.The seven newly appointed national vice presidents of the BJP OBC Morcha are Jogen Mohan (Assam), Mamata Mohanta (Odisha), Sangam Lal Gupta (Uttar Pradesh), Babanrao Ravji Choudhary (Maharashtra), Sat Prakash Rana (Delhi), Arjun Sahani (Bihar), and Sangeeta Balwant Bind (Uttar Pradesh).Gajendra Yadav (Delhi), Pramod Madhwaraj (Karnataka), and Lalit Chandrakar (Chhattisgarh) have been named as national general secretaries.The party also appointed seven national secretaries: Dashrathji Thakor (Gujarat), T Varatharajan (Tamil Nadu), Sanjeev Kumar alias Bablu Bhagat (Jharkhand), Sarita Jangid (Haryana), Kadaganchi Ramesh (Telangana), Vaibhav Panwar (Madhya Pradesh), and Bhim Kumar Sahu (Bihar).Under the organisational appointments, Radheshyam Yadav from Uttar Pradesh has been given charge as the national treasurer.Sanjay Kumar Gurjar and Dr Arun Yadav (both from Delhi) have been appointed as national office secretary and co-office secretary, respectively. Ajay Gupta from Bihar has been named the media coordinator for the Morcha.For digital communication, Parikshit Dagar (Delhi) has been appointed social media coordinator, with Pradeep Mahaur Soni (Madhya Pradesh) named co-coordinator. Prof. Pankaj Choudhary (Delhi) will head the policy and research wing as coordinator, assisted by co-coordinators Ashutosh Behera (Odisha) and Rahul Yadav (Uttar Pradesh).The party also notified the initial names of the national executive committee members, including Sanjeev Rangaiya (Andaman & Nicobar), Srinivas Rao Kantubukta (Andhra Pradesh), Rajiv Ranjan alias Vishal Yadav (Bihar), and Sanjeev Verma (Chandigarh). headline: HP Assembly passes resolution for permanent High Court Bench in Dharamsala
content: The Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly on Saturday unanimously passed a resolution urging the Central Government to establish a permanent Bench of the Himachal Pradesh High Court in Dharamsala.Moving the resolution during the concluding day of the winter session at Tapovan, Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu said that the Article 214 of the Constitution of India and Section 51(2) of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956, empower the President of India to establish a permanent Bench of a High Court at a place other than its principal seat, after consultation with the Governor of the state and the Chief Justice of the High Court.He noted that litigants, advocates and the general public from Kangra and other districts of lower Himachal face severe hardship, heavy financial burden and avoidable delays in accessing timely justice due to the long geographical distance and difficult terrain separating the region from the principal seat of the High Court in Shimla.Citing the high volume of pending cases originating from Kangra and adjoining districts, the resolution stated that setting up a dedicated Bench is fully justified to ensure speedy, accessible and affordable justice at the citizens' doorstep.He also said that the House unanimously resolves to immediately forward a formal and detailed proposal to the Government of India after consulting the Chief Justice of the High Court and the Governor.The chief minister also reaffirmed the government's commitment to providing clean land, court buildings, residential complexes, digital infrastructure and financial resources to make the Dharamsala Bench operational at the earliest. Clarifying the intent behind the move, the chief minister said that the initiative is not aimed at diminishing the importance of Shimla, but rather at making justice accessible to a larger section of the state's population.

headline: Last rites of UP CM Yogi Adityanaths mother held in Haridwar
content: The last rites of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s mother were held at the Chandi Ghat in Haridwar on Saturday.Adityanath paid floral tributes to his mother’s remains before they were taken to the funeral pyre. His younger brother then consigned it to flames.Adityanath’s mother, Savitri Devi, passed away at her native village in Uttarakhand on Friday morning at the age of 91.On Saturday morning, the UP chief minister and his family took his mother’s remains from her ancestral home in Panchur village in Pauri Garhwal district for the funeral at Chandi Ghat cremation ground in Haridwar.At the ghat, Adityanath looked emotional as he stood by his mother’s remains. After paying respect to his mother at their home, Adityanath shared on X, “There is no shade like a mother’s, no refuge like a mother’s. There is no protection like a mother’s, no love like a mother’s.”नास्ति मातृसमा छाया नास्ति मातृसमा गतिः।नास्ति मातृसमं त्राणं नास्ति मातृसमा प्रिया॥🙏 https://t.co/usBszRtWjQ— Yogi Adityanath (@myogiadityanath) November 21, 2026A large crowd has gathered at the Namami Gange Ghat, also known as Chandi Ghat, to pay their respects. Tight security arrangements are in place.Prominent politicians, ministers, party officials from both Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, including Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, as well as seers and representatives from various social organisations were present at the ghat.Senior UP ministers like Sanjay Nishad and many senior bureaucrats were also spotted at the place.Top leaders including Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, along with many chief ministers, top opposition leaders like Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and veteran leader Azam Khan, BSP chief Mayawati, and Congress leaders like UPCC chief Aradhana Misra Mona have mourned the demise of Adityanath’s mother.Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Swatantra Dev Singh and Minister of State Kunwar Brijesh Rawat also expressed their condolences and paid tribute to Adityanath’s mother.Several saints, including yoga guru Baba Ramdev, Mishri Math Peethadhishwar Karoli Shankar and Akhada Parishad president Mahant Ravindra Puri, also paid their respects, describing her passing as an irreparable loss.

headline: Punjab: Ex-kabaddi captain Yadwinder Singh joins AAP
content: International kabaddi star and former captain of the Indian kabaddi team, Yadwinder Singh ‘Yada Surakhpuria’, joined the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) on Friday, with Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann welcoming him into the party and expressing confidence that his association would strengthen Punjab’s sporting culture.In a message posted on X, Mann said, “Warmly welcome international kabaddi star and former captain of the Indian kabaddi team, Yadwinder Singh ‘Yada Surakhpuria’, into the Aam Aadmi Party family. Yada, who was named the Best Stopper in the World Cup and is currently serving as the Sarpanch of Surakhpur village in Sultanpur Lodhi, has brought immense pride to Punjab through his sporting achievements on the global stage.”The Chief Minister further said, “The joining of sports leaders like him will further strengthen our efforts to promote a vibrant sports culture in the state and keep the youth away from drugs. Heartfelt best wishes to Yada Ji for this new innings. Let us work together to build a ‘Rangla Punjab’.”Mann said the association of sports personalities with the party would help encourage young people to embrace sports, discipline and positive pursuits. He expressed confidence that Yadwinder Singh’s experience and contribution to sports would inspire the younger generation and strengthen efforts to make Punjab a leading sporting state.

headline: Shiv Sena’s Sanjay Raut calls to rename Nagpur as Deekshabhoomi; Congress backs demand
content: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut on Friday (November 20, 2026) called for renaming Nagpur as Deekshabhoomi, saying it would be a greater tribute to Dr B.R. Ambedkar than changing the name of a metro station in Mumbai., he said. https://www.thehindu.com/topic/rajya-sabha-mp-sanjay-raut/ Ambedkar’s extraordinary leadership storyline 1 https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/mumbai/ Mr. Raut’s demand came a day after the Maharashtra Government granted in-principle approval to rename Dadar metro station as Chaityabhoomi, in honour of the memorial in Dadar where Dr Ambedkar’s last rites were performed and his body was cremated following his death in December 1956. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/maharashtra/ Rename Mumbai Central station after Ambedkar: Ramdas Athawale Rename Mumbai Central station after Ambedkar: Ramdas Athawale Ramdas Athawale to raise demand with Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, Railway Minister Piyush Goyal story Rename Mumbai Central station after Ambedkar: Ramdas Athawale “Dadar is just a station. The biggest honour to Dr Ambedkar would be to change Nagpur’s name to Deekshabhoomi,” Mr. Raut told reporters on Friday (November 20). He said Ambedkar’s social revolution began at Deekshabhoomi in Nagpur and added that his party would support the government if any dispute arose over the proposed renaming. Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar also backed the demand, citing Ambedkar’s immense contribution to the country. He said Deekshabhoomi should receive greater recognition and attract visitors from across the world. In a post on X, Mr. Wadettiwar also criticised the state government over delays in the construction of Dr Ambedkar’s international memorial at Indu Mill in Mumbai, alleging that the project had remained stalled for 10 years. Ban also questioned Raut’s commitment to Ambedkar’s legacy, alleging that he neither visits Chaityabhoomi nor propagates Ambedkar’s ideology.

headline: Odisha government orders inquiry into foreign visits by former CM Naveen Patnaik, aide Pandian
content: BHUBANESWAR The Odisha government on Saturday (November 21, 2026) ordered an inquiry into visits by former Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik and his close aide, retired IAS officer V.K. Pandian, to Japan and Italy during 2022-23 and 2023-24. As per the directions issued by Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, the Principal Secretary of the General Administration Department will conduct the investigation. The inquiry was ordered after social activists alleged that the expenditure details relating to the visits to Japan and Italy were suspicious, unclear and incomplete, the Chief Minister’s Office (CMO) said here on Saturday (November 21, 2026). Mohan Charan Majhi government epitome of mismanagement: Naveen Patnaik Mohan Charan Majhi government epitome of mismanagement: Naveen Patnaik BJD launches ‘Jan Sampark Padayatra’, its annual month-long public outreach programme on occasion birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi Mohan Charan Majhi government epitome of mismanagement: Naveen Patnaik storyline 1 Based on information obtained through various Right to Information (RTI) applications, activists had filed a complaint alleging that Biju Janata Dal chief Mr. Patnaik, IAS officer Mr. Pandian and IPS officer Ravikant had undertaken several foreign visits during 2022-23 and 2023-24, when Mr. Patnaik was the Chief Minister. The CMO further said that the activists had alleged that information regarding these visits was deliberately kept confidential, resulting in inconsistencies and discrepancies in the available records. “In view of these allegations, Mr. Majhi has directed an investigation to ascertain the facts and bring the truth to light,” the CMO said. “We had sought details of the visits by former CM Mr. Patnaik, Mr. Pandian and Mr. Ravi Kant, who was then Resident Commissioner for Odisha government and posted at Delhi to Rome from June 20 to 25 in 2022,” said RTI activist Pradip Pradhan, who had filed a complaint with the State government regarding the foreign visit. Former CM Naveen Patnaik hits out at Odisha govt, alleging ‘callous’ of handling of school textbooks Former CM Naveen Patnaik hits out at Odisha govt, alleging ‘callous’ of handling of school textbooks Demanding resignation of School and Mass Education Minister Nityanand Gond, BJD hit the street and charged massive embezzlement of government fund in printing of textbooks Former CM Naveen Patnaik hits out at Odisha govt, alleging ‘callous’ of handling of school textbooks storyline 1 “We got suspicious about the visit because ₹83 lakh was spent from the State exchequer. The bill for the visit was generated by office of Odisha’s Resident Commissioner, New Delhi and it was footed by Parliamentary Affairs department of the State,” he said. “A group of RTI activists including me had moved General Administration, Home Department, Transport Department and Parliamentary Affairs of Odisha Government. Even information was sought from Indian Embassy at Rome. None of them had provided any information stating that the report regarding the visits were not available with them,” Mr. Pradhan alleged. The complaint stated that the State had decided to send a delegation of senior functionaries to Japan, led by former Chief Minister Mr. Patnaik, to attract investments. Odisha’s industrial promotion body, IPICOL, was entrusted with coordinating the programme. Trade chamber FICCI was awarded the work of managing the entire Investors’ Meet in Japan on behalf of the government. An amount of ₹63 lakh was spent on air tickets for officers. An amount of ₹9.80 crore was provided to FICCI in advance to meet all expenses of the nine-day programme scheduled from April 2 to 11, 2023. Similarly, the Department of Transport, Odisha government, supplied a bill amounting to ₹1,63,02,880, paid towards hiring a chartered flight provided for Mr. Patnaik on April 3, 2023 (from Bhubaneswar to Singapore) and on April 11, 2023 (from Bangkok to Bhubaneswar). “It means Mr. Patnaik and Mr. Pandian had travelled to Japan via Singapore returned to Bhubaneswar via Bangkok. The question arises why both Mr. Patnaik and Mr. Pandian had gone to Singapore by a special aircraft and who are others who accompanied them to Singapore. This question was asked to Department of General Administration and office of the Chief Minister, Odisha. The PIO of both the offices responded non-availability of information, which requires a thorough inquiry by an investigating agency,” activists demanded.

headline: PM, HM still searching for ‘supertainted’ two-thirds majority for delimitation bill, says Congress

नए विधेयक में क्या होगा, क्योंकि पुराना विधेयक 17 अप्रैल, 2026 को भारी बहुमत से गिर चुका है। किसी भी राजनीतिक दल के साथ नए और ठोस प्रस्तावों पर गंभीरता से, व्यवस्थित तरीके से कोई चर्चा नहीं हुई है। यहां तक कि मल्लिकार्जुन खरगे जी द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री को चार पत्र लिखे जाने के बावजूद अब तक सर्वदलीय बैठक भी नहीं बुलाई गई है। देश के सामने आर्थिक, राजनीतिक, सामाजिक, सैन्य और विदेश नीति से जुड़ी कहीं अधिक गंभीर और ज़रूरी चुनौतियां हैं, जिन पर तत्काल ध्यान देने की ज़रूरत है। व्यापक और दूरगामी परिसीमन को फ़िलहाल टाला जा सकता है। 1976 में इंदिरा गांधी ने इसे 25 वर्षों के लिए टाल दिया था। 2001 में अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी ने इसे अगले 25 वर्षों के लिए, यानी 2026 के बाद होने वाली पहली जनगणना के नतीजे प्रकाशित होने तक, टाल दिया था। वे विवेकशील और राष्ट्रहित को सर्वोपरि रखने वाले प्रधानमंत्री थे। 19 नवंबर को FICCI सम्मेलन में प्रधानमंत्री ने अर्थव्यवस्था की स्थिति को लेकर गंभीर चिंता जताई थी। ऐसा प्रतीत होता है कि वे मानसिक रूप से काफ़ी विचलित हैं, और ऐसा होना स्वाभाविक भी है। परिसीमन पर बहस और चर्चा के लिए ऐसे शांतचित्त लोगों की ज़रूरत है, जो उन तनावों से मुक्त हों जिनसे प्रधानमंत्री घिरे हुए हैं। इसके लिए विभिन्न हितधारकों के साथ व्यापक विचार-विमर्श भी ज़रूरी है। ऐसी परिस्थितियों में देश के हित में यही होगा कि लोकसभा की मौजूदा सदस्य संख्या और राज्यों के प्रतिनिधित्व का वर्तमान स्वरूप बरकरार रखा जाए और वर्तमान राज्यवार सीटों का मौजूदा बँटवारे में ही महिलाओं के लिए एक-तिहाई आरक्षण लागू कर दिया It will be a fitting tribute to it since the consequences of a fundamentally new delimitation can best be managed in an environment when Viksit Bharat has become a reality," the Congress leader said.
